lines.say: A shepherd boy against a giant warrior. Who wins? Let's find out!
David was the youngest son in his family. He looked after his father's sheep.
One day, two armies faced each other on the hills, ready for battle.
And every day a giant named Goliath stepped out and shouted: send me your best fighter!
Nobody dared. The soldiers hid behind their shields, for forty days.
Then David arrived, bringing food for his brothers. He said: I'll fight him!
The king gave David his armor. But it was way too big and heavy!
So David picked five smooth stones from a stream, and took his sling.
He ran forward, spinning the sling above his head.
The stone flew, and hit the giant right on the forehead!
Down came Goliath like a falling tree, and the whole army cheered!
The smallest one won. That's why we still say: a David and Goliath story. Follow for more!
